decisions.choice: verse numbers: the Hebrew text begins chapter 6 here
decisions.reason: This translation numbers verses as the Hebrew text does. In the Hebrew text chapter 5 runs on to verse 41, and its last fifteen verses (5:27-41 here), the line of the high priests, are numbered 6:1-15 in many Bibles. So this chapter's verses 1-66 are numbered 6:16-81 in those Bibles. The words are the same; only the numbers differ.

decisions.choice: Gershom: the son of Levi called Gershon in Exodus 6:16 and Numbers 3:17
decisions.reason: Levi's first son is Gershon in Genesis 46:11, Exodus 6:16, Numbers 3:17 and 1 Chronicles 5:27, but this chapter spells his name Gershom each time (verses 2, 5, 28, 47, 56). The two forms name the same man. He is not Gershom the son of Moses (Exodus 2:22).

decisions.choice: a new start: the whole tribe of Levi
decisions.reason: The list in 5:27-41 followed only the line of the high priests. Here the writer starts again from Levi's three sons, to give the other Levite families (verses 1-15), the singers David appointed (verses 16-32), and the towns the Levites lived in (verses 39-66).

decisions.choice: The sons of X: A, B and C
decisions.reason: The list formula is kept the same through these chapters. Literal and Balanced keep the bare heading with a colon, as the Hebrew does; Readable adds "were" to make a sentence.

decisions.choice: "Gersón"
decisions.reason: Chronicles spells Levi's son Gershom here and Gershon in 5:27; Spanish writes both "Gersón", the form of the published Exodus 6:16, and his sons keep the Exodus forms "Libní" and "Simí", as do Merari's sons "Majlí" and "Musí".

decisions.choice: Guershom, as the Hebrew spells the name here
decisions.reason: The meaning decision (m2) notes that this is Levi's son Guershon of Exodus 6:16 (5:27 above); French keeps the spelling of this verse, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Ghẹt-sôm", the spelling of this chapter
decisions.reason: 5:27 and the Vietnamese Genesis 46:11 have "Ghẹt-sôn"; this chapter spells the name Gershom each time, and the Vietnamese follows it, as the English does.

decisions.reason: Asaph's line in verses 24-28 also goes back to Gershom through Zimmah and Jahath, but there Shimei stands between Zimmah and Jahath, and Jahath is the son of Gershom without Libni. The two lists give different links in the same family line.

ko.L: 그리고 이들은 궤가 안치된 뒤에 다윗이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서 노래의 일을 맡게 세운 이들이다.
ko.B: 궤를 안치한 뒤에 다윗이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서 노래하는 일을 맡긴 사람들은 이러하다.
ko.R: 궤가 머무를 곳에 자리를 잡은 뒤에, 다윗은 이 사람들에게 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서 노래하는 일을 맡겼다.

decisions.choice: over the hands of song: in charge of the singing
decisions.reason: "Hands" here means the charge or direction of a task, as when work is done "under the hands" of a leader (25:2-3). David set these men over the singing in worship.

decisions.choice: after the ark came to rest: when David brought it to Jerusalem
decisions.reason: David brought the ark of the LORD to Jerusalem and set it in the tent he had pitched for it (2 Samuel 6:17; 1 Chronicles 15:1; 16:1). After that the ark no longer moved from place to place, and David appointed Levites to sing and play before it (15:16-22; 16:4-7). The "resting place" of the ark is also sung of in Psalm 132:8 and 2 Chronicles 6:41.

decisions.choice: the house of the LORD: the place of the LORD's worship before the temple
decisions.reason: The temple was not yet built (verse 17). The phrase names the place where the LORD was worshiped, here the tent sanctuary, as "the house of the LORD" is used of the sanctuary at Shiloh (1 Samuel 1:7).

decisions.choice: the singing
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is "song"; Balanced and Readable say "the singing", the activity these men led. Literal keeps "song".

decisions.choice: nyumba ya BWANA (R too)
decisions.reason: The terms note sets "nyumba ya BWANA" at Literal and Balanced and "hekalu" at Readable for the temple; here the house is the place of worship before the temple was built, so Readable keeps "nyumba" too, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "hòm giao ước" for "the ark"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "the ark"; Vietnamese needs a fuller name for it to be understood, and the Samuel terms give "hòm giao ước" as one of its names.

decisions.choice: "trên các tay của việc ca hát" kept at Literal
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of the "hands" of the song, as the English Literal does; Balanced and Readable say "coi sóc việc ca hát".

decisions.choice: "노래의 일" (L), "노래하는 일" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Over the hands of song" means in charge of the singing (m1); Korean has no such use of "손", so Literal says "the work of song".

records.literal_gloss: And they were serving before [the] tabernacle of [the] tent of meeting with song until built Solomon the house of Yahweh in Jerusalem; and they stood according to their rule over their service.

en.L: And they were ministering before the tabernacle of the tent of meeting with song until Solomon built the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in Jerusalem; and they stood according to their rule for their service.
en.B: Until Solomon built the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in Jerusalem, they ministered with song before the tabernacle of the tent of meeting, carrying out their service in the order laid down for them.
en.R: They served with songs in front of the tabernacle, the meeting tent, until Solomon built the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in Jerusalem. They did their work in the way that had been set for them.

ko.B: 솔로몬이 예루살렘에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집을 지을 때까지, 그들은 회막의 성막 앞에서 노래로 섬기며 자기들에게 정해진 규례에 따라 직무를 맡아 했다.
ko.R: 솔로몬이 예루살렘에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전을 지을 때까지, 그들은 성막, 곧 만남의 장막 앞에서 노래로 섬겼다. 그들은 자기들에게 정해진 방식대로 일했다.

decisions.choice: the tabernacle of the tent of meeting: the tent sanctuary made under Moses
decisions.reason: The full name is used for the sanctuary Moses set up (Exodus 39:32; 40:2). In David's time the tabernacle stood at Gibeon, while the ark was in the tent David had pitched in Jerusalem (16:1, 39; 21:29). The singers served at both places (16:37-42), and here the phrase stands for the whole of that worship before the temple was built.

decisions.choice: ministering: serving in worship
decisions.reason: The verb is used of the service of priests and Levites at the sanctuary (Numbers 3:6; 1 Chronicles 16:4, 37).

decisions.choice: they stood according to their rule: they served in the prescribed order
decisions.reason: To "stand" at a task is to serve at one's post. The word for "rule" is often "judgment" or "custom"; here it is the order fixed for their work (15:13; 23:31).

decisions.choice: the meeting tent; the temple
decisions.reason: Readable says "the meeting tent" for "the tent of meeting", as elsewhere, and "temple" for the house Solomon built, as in 1 Kings 6:1. Literal and Balanced keep "house".

decisions.choice: "el tabernáculo de la Tienda del Encuentro"; "la casa" (L, B), "el templo" (R)
decisions.reason: The tent keeps the name of the published Spanish Exodus ("la Tienda del Encuentro") at every level; the house of the LORD is "la casa" at Literal and Balanced and "el templo" at Readable, as the terms note sets.

decisions.choice: la Demeure, la tente de la Rencontre (L, B); la tente sacrée (R)
decisions.reason: The terms of the Pentateuch note for *mishkan* and *ʾohel moʿed*; Readable says what the Demeure was, as the English Readable does, and "le temple" for the house Solomon built (terms note).

decisions.choice: "Đền Tạm" for the tabernacle; "Lều Hội Kiến" for the tent of meeting
decisions.reason: "Lều Hội Kiến" is the name the Vietnamese 1 Kings 8:4 uses; "Đền Tạm" names the tent sanctuary as a dwelling.

decisions.choice: "만남의 장막" for the tent of meeting at Readable
decisions.reason: "회막" is the usual word at Literal and Balanced; Readable says what it is, as the English "meeting tent" does.

decisions.choice: those standing: those who served at their posts
decisions.reason: As in verse 17, "stand" means to serve. These are the leaders of the singers, each with his sons serving under him (25:1-6).

decisions.choice: three leaders, each traced back to Levi
decisions.reason: Heman of Kohath's line stands in the middle (verses 18-23), Asaph of Gershom's line at his right (verses 24-28) and Ethan of Merari's line at his left (verses 29-32). Each line is traced up to Levi, so all three branches of the tribe share in the singing.

decisions.choice: son of Joel, son of Samuel: the grandson of the prophet Samuel
decisions.reason: Joel was Samuel's firstborn son (1 Samuel 8:2; see the note on verse 13). Heman led the singers with Asaph and Ethan (15:17, 19; 25:1). A Heman is also named in the title of Psalm 88.

decisions.choice: He was the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,
decisions.reason: Readable starts a new sentence for the line of ancestors, which runs on to verse 23.

decisions.choice: the chain of fathers kept in the Hebrew order across verses 18-23
alternatives: 레위의 아들 그핫의 아들 ... 요엘의 아들 헤만
decisions.reason: The line runs over six verses, so Korean cannot put the fathers first. Literal keeps the Hebrew chain ("요엘의 아들, 사무엘의 아들, ..."); Balanced and Readable say each link ("요엘은 사무엘의 아들"). Asaph's line (24-28) and Ethan's (29-32) are set the same way.

decisions.choice: and Aaron: set against the Levites of verse 33
decisions.reason: The Levites served the sanctuary, but the work at the altars and in the holy place belonged to Aaron and his descendants alone (Numbers 18:1-7).

decisions.choice: making smoke: burning offerings so that they go up in smoke
decisions.reason: The verb covers both altars: the burnt offerings on the bronze altar in the courtyard (Exodus 27:1-8) and the incense on the gold altar inside the tent (Exodus 30:1-10).

decisions.choice: the holy of holies: the Most Holy Place
decisions.reason: The phrase names the inner room where the ark stood (Exodus 26:33-34). The work there was the high priest's, above all on the Day of Atonement (Leviticus 16). The same words can mean "the most holy things" (Numbers 4:4), but the setting beside atonement points to the place.

decisions.choice: make atonement for Israel
decisions.reason: Through the offerings the priests made, the sins of Israel were covered and the people made right with God (Leviticus 16:32-34).

decisions.choice: the slave of God: Moses' title of honor
decisions.reason: The word names a person who belongs to a master and serves him, not a hired worker. Said of Moses it is a title of honor (Numbers 12:7; Deuteronomy 34:5; Joshua 1:1). The priests' work followed what the LORD had commanded through him.

decisions.choice: slave (Literal); servant (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As elsewhere for Moses, Literal keeps "slave" to show the word's hard edge, and Balanced and Readable say "servant", the fitting word for a trusted man in his master's service.

decisions.choice: [offerings]; made the offerings go up in smoke (Balanced); burned the offerings ... burned incense (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verb has no object. Literal supplies "offerings" in brackets and Balanced keeps the picture of the smoke; Readable names what was burned on each altar.

decisions.choice: "siervo" at every level
decisions.reason: God's servants (Moses, David, the prophets) are "siervo" at every level in the Spanish Samuel and Kings, though the English Literal says "slave": the word is a title of honor here (m5).

decisions.choice: "el lugar santísimo"
decisions.reason: The inner room (m3) is "el lugar santísimo", as the published Exodus 26:34.

decisions.choice: obtenaient le pardon pour Israël
decisions.reason: The Pentateuch note keeps "faire l'expiation pour" at Literal and Balanced and lets Readable say what it achieves; "obtenir le pardon" is the plain French for it.

decisions.choice: mtumishi wa Mungu at Literal too
decisions.reason: The Swahili Kings drafts give God's named servants (Moses, David, the prophets) "mtumishi" at every level, Literal included; Chronicles follows them, where the English Literal says "slave".

decisions.choice: "đầy tớ của Đức Chúa Trời" at every level, Literal included
alternatives: nô lệ của Đức Chúa Trời (L)
decisions.reason: The English Literal says "slave", but in Vietnamese "nô lệ" for God's servant Moses reads as degrading rather than as a title of honor; "đầy tớ" is used for God's servants at every level in these books, as the Samuel note does for "my servant David".

decisions.choice: "Nơi Chí Thánh"
decisions.reason: The name the terms note gives for the most holy place; the meaning decision explains why the room, not the most holy things, is meant.

decisions.choice: "지극히 거룩한 곳" (L), "지성소" (B, R); "하나님의 종" at every level
alternatives: 지극히 거룩한 곳 at every level; 하나님의 노예
decisions.reason: As in the Korean 1 Kings, Literal says the holy of holies word for word and Balanced and Readable use "지성소"; Korean "종" covers both the slave of Literal and the servant of Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: dwelling places ... encampments: the Levites' settlements
decisions.reason: The first word means places to live; the second names an enclosed camp or settlement (Genesis 25:16; Numbers 31:10). "Their" refers to the Levites of the lists before.

decisions.choice: for theirs was the lot: the first lot, as in Joshua 21:10
decisions.reason: From here to verse 66 the chapter follows the list of Levite towns in Joshua 21:10-39, sometimes with other names or fewer towns. Joshua 21:10 says "for theirs was the first lot"; Chronicles has the shorter wording, with the same sense: the priests' share was drawn first, and so it is listed first.

decisions.choice: the priests first, then the rest of the Levites
decisions.reason: Joshua gives the totals for each Levite group before the towns (Joshua 21:4-8); Chronicles names the priests' towns first (verses 40-45) and then gives the totals and the other towns (verses 46-66).

decisions.choice: the Levites; first
decisions.reason: Readable names who "they" are and adds "first" from the sense of the lot (m2; Joshua 21:10). The other levels keep the shorter wording.

decisions.reason: Balanced puts the priests first, as the Hebrew does, and ends with the lot.

sw.R: Waliwapa wazao wa Haruni Hebroni, mmojawapo wa miji ya usalama, ambako mtu aliyemuua mwenzake angeweza kukimbilia ili alindwe. Waliwapa pia Libna na malisho yake, Yatiri, na Eshtemoa na malisho yake.

vi.L: Và cho các con trai của A-rôn họ cho các thành ẩn náu: Hếp-rôn; và Líp-na cùng các đồng cỏ của nó, và Giạt-thia, và Ếch-tê-mô-a cùng các đồng cỏ của nó,
vi.B: Họ cấp cho con cháu A-rôn một trong các thành ẩn náu là Hếp-rôn, cùng với Líp-na và các đồng cỏ của nó, Giạt-thia, và Ếch-tê-mô-a và các đồng cỏ của nó,
vi.R: Họ cấp cho con cháu A-rôn thành Hếp-rôn. Đó là một trong các thành ẩn náu, nơi người lỡ tay giết người có thể chạy đến để được bảo vệ. Họ cũng cấp Líp-na và các đồng cỏ của nó, Giạt-thia, và Ếch-tê-mô-a và các đồng cỏ của nó.

ko.L: 그리고 아론 자손에게 도피성들, 곧 헤브론과, 립나와 그 목초지와, 얏딜과, 에스드모아와 그 목초지와,
ko.B: 아론 자손에게는 도피성 가운데 하나인 헤브론과 함께 립나와 그 목초지와, 얏딜과, 에스드모아와 그 목초지와,
ko.R: 그들은 아론 자손에게 헤브론을 주었다. 헤브론은 피난 성읍, 곧 사람을 죽인 사람이 보호를 받으려고 피할 수 있는 성읍 가운데 하나였다. 또 립나와 그 목초지와, 얏딜과, 에스드모아와 그 목초지를 주었다.

decisions.choice: the cities of refuge: Hebron as one of the cities of refuge
alternatives: the plural taken with all the towns of the list
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has the plural, but of the towns named here only Hebron was a city of refuge (Joshua 20:7). Joshua 21:13 has the singular, "the city of refuge for the killer, Hebron". The plural is read as naming Hebron as one of that class of towns.

decisions.choice: the list follows Joshua 21:13-14
decisions.reason: Joshua also gives Hebron and Jattir "and its pasturelands"; Chronicles leaves the words out after Jattir, and after Hebron, whose pasturelands were named in verse 40. Libnah, Jattir and Eshtemoa are towns of Judah (Joshua 15:42, 48, 50).

decisions.choice: cities of refuge (Balanced); towns of safety (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in Numbers 35 and Joshua 20-21. Readable explains once what the towns were for.

decisions.choice: "ciudades de refugio"; R explains once
decisions.reason: Spanish keeps the usual name "ciudades de refugio" at every level; Readable explains once what the towns were for, as the English does.

decisions.choice: villes de refuge, explained at Readable
decisions.reason: "Ville de refuge" is the usual French name for these towns and is clear in itself; Readable adds what they were for, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: miji ya makimbilio (L, B); miji ya usalama (R)
decisions.reason: The cities of refuge are "miji ya makimbilio"; Readable says "towns of safety" and explains once what they were for, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "thành ẩn náu"; Readable explains it
decisions.reason: One name for the cities of refuge at every level; Readable says what they were for, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "피난 성읍" explained at Readable
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced use the usual term "도피성"; Readable says what such a town was for, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Hilez (the Leningrad Codex)
decisions.reason: The Leningrad Codex, the manuscript on which the printed Hebrew text is based, spells this name Hilez; other Hebrew manuscripts and printed editions have Hilen. Joshua 21:15 has Holon, a town of Judah (Joshua 15:51), and the names probably refer to the same place. The Leningrad spelling is followed, though the other spelling may be the original.

decisions.choice: Ashan: where Joshua 21:16 has Ain; Juttah not named
decisions.reason: Joshua 21:16 has Ain and Juttah before Beth-shemesh. Ashan and Ain were neighboring towns of Simeon (Joshua 19:7; 1 Chronicles 4:32), and either name may stand for the same place; Juttah does not appear in this list.

source.text: וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה בִנְיָמִ֗ן אֶת־גֶּ֤בַע וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֨יהָ֙ וְאֶת־עָלֶ֣מֶת וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֔יהָ וְאֶת־עֲנָת֖וֹת וְאֶת־מִגְרָשֶׁ֑יהָ כָּל־עָרֵיהֶ֛ם שְׁלֹשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה עִ֖יר בְּמִשְׁפְּחוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And from [the] tribe of Benjamin, Geba and its pasture lands, and Alemeth and its pasture lands, and Anathoth and its pasture lands; all their cities: thirteen cities in their clans.

en.L: And from the tribe of Benjamin: Geba and its pasturelands, and Alemeth and its pasturelands, and Anathoth and its pasturelands. All their cities [were] thirteen cities, by their clans.
en.B: From the tribe of Benjamin they gave Geba and its pasturelands, Alemeth and its pasturelands, and Anathoth and its pasturelands. Their towns numbered thirteen in all, clan by clan.
en.R: From the tribe of Benjamin they gave Geba and its pasturelands, Alemeth and its pasturelands, and Anathoth and its pasturelands. The priests' clans received thirteen towns in all.

es.L: Y de la tribu de Benjamín: Geba y sus pastizales, y Alemet y sus pastizales, y Anatot y sus pastizales. Todas sus ciudades [fueron] trece ciudades, por sus clanes.
es.B: De la tribu de Benjamín les dieron Geba y sus pastizales, Alemet y sus pastizales, y Anatot y sus pastizales. Sus ciudades fueron trece en total, clan por clan.
es.R: De la tribu de Benjamín les dieron Geba y sus pastizales, Alemet y sus pastizales, y Anatot y sus pastizales. Los clanes de los sacerdotes recibieron trece ciudades en total.

fr.L: Et de la tribu de Benjamin : Guéba et ses pâturages, et Alémeth et ses pâturages, et Anatoth et ses pâturages. Toutes leurs villes : treize villes, selon leurs clans.
fr.B: De la tribu de Benjamin, on leur donna Guéba et ses pâturages, Alémeth et ses pâturages, et Anatoth et ses pâturages. Leurs villes étaient au nombre de treize en tout, clan par clan.
fr.R: De la tribu de Benjamin, on leur a donné Guéba et ses pâturages, Alémeth et ses pâturages, et Anatoth et ses pâturages. Les clans des prêtres ont reçu treize villes en tout.

sw.L: Na kutoka kabila la Benyamini: Geba na malisho yake, na Alemethi na malisho yake, na Anathothi na malisho yake. Miji yao yote [ilikuwa] miji kumi na mitatu, kwa koo zao.
sw.B: Kutoka kabila la Benyamini waliwapa Geba na malisho yake, Alemethi na malisho yake, na Anathothi na malisho yake. Miji yao ilikuwa kumi na mitatu kwa jumla, ukoo kwa ukoo.
sw.R: Kutoka kabila la Benyamini waliwapa Geba na malisho yake, Alemethi na malisho yake, na Anathothi na malisho yake. Koo za makuhani zilipata miji kumi na mitatu kwa jumla.

vi.L: Và từ chi tộc Bên-gia-min: Ghê-ba cùng các đồng cỏ của nó, A-lê-mết cùng các đồng cỏ của nó, và A-na-tốt cùng các đồng cỏ của nó. Tất cả các thành của họ [là] mười ba thành, theo họ hàng của họ.
vi.B: Từ chi tộc Bên-gia-min, họ cấp Ghê-ba và các đồng cỏ của nó, A-lê-mết và các đồng cỏ của nó, và A-na-tốt và các đồng cỏ của nó. Tổng cộng các thành của họ là mười ba thành, chia theo gia tộc.
vi.R: Từ chi tộc Bên-gia-min, họ cấp Ghê-ba và các đồng cỏ của nó, A-lê-mết và các đồng cỏ của nó, và A-na-tốt và các đồng cỏ của nó. Các gia tộc thầy tế lễ nhận được tất cả mười ba thành.

ko.L: 그리고 베냐민 지파에서는 게바와 그 목초지와, 알레멧과 그 목초지와, 아나돗과 그 목초지이다. 그들의 모든 성읍은 그들의 씨족별로 열세 성읍이다.
ko.B: 베냐민 지파에서는 게바와 그 목초지와, 알레멧과 그 목초지와, 아나돗과 그 목초지를 주었다. 그들이 받은 성읍은 씨족별로 모두 열세 성읍이었다.
ko.R: 베냐민 지파에서는 게바와 그 목초지와, 알레멧과 그 목초지와, 아나돗과 그 목초지를 주었다. 제사장 씨족들이 받은 성읍은 모두 열세 성읍이었다.

decisions.choice: Benjamin's towns: Gibeon is not named, and Alemeth is Almon
decisions.reason: Joshua 21:17-18 lists Gibeon, Geba, Anathoth and Almon. Chronicles does not name Gibeon, and calls Almon Alemeth.

decisions.choice: thirteen: the total of Joshua 21:19, though only eleven are named
decisions.reason: The total matches Joshua 21:4 and 21:19. Juttah and Gibeon, which Joshua counts, are not named in this list, so the names come to eleven.

decisions.choice: they gave; The priests' clans
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable supply the verb, as in Joshua 21:17, and Readable names whose towns these were (verse 42).

records.literal_gloss: And to [the] sons of Kohath the remaining, from [the] clan of the tribe, from [the] half of [the] tribe, half Manasseh, by the lot, cities ten.

en.L: And to the sons of Kohath who remained, from the clan of the tribe, from the half of the tribe, half Manasseh, by lot, ten cities.
en.B: The rest of the descendants of Kohath received ten towns by lot from the clan of the tribe and from the half-tribe of Manasseh.
en.R: The rest of Kohath's descendants received ten towns by lot from the tribes, including half the tribe of Manasseh.

es.L: Y a los hijos de Coat que quedaban, del clan de la tribu, de la mitad de la tribu, la media [tribu de] Manasés, por suerte, diez ciudades.
es.B: Los demás descendientes de Coat recibieron por suerte diez ciudades del clan de la tribu y de la media tribu de Manasés.
es.R: Los demás descendientes de Coat recibieron por suerte diez ciudades de las tribus, incluida la mitad de la tribu de Manasés.

fr.L: Et aux fils de Kehath qui restaient, du clan de la tribu, de la moitié de la tribu, la demi-[tribu de] Manassé, par le sort, dix villes.
fr.B: Le reste des descendants de Kehath reçut par le sort dix villes du clan de la tribu et de la demi-tribu de Manassé.
fr.R: Le reste des descendants de Kehath a reçu par tirage au sort dix villes des tribus, parmi lesquelles la moitié de la tribu de Manassé.

sw.L: Na kwa wana wa Kohathi waliobaki, kutoka ukoo wa kabila, kutoka nusu ya kabila, nusu ya Manase, kwa kura, miji kumi.
sw.B: Wazao wengine wa Kohathi walipata miji kumi kwa kura kutoka ukoo wa kabila na kutoka nusu ya kabila la Manase.
sw.R: Wazao wengine wa Kohathi walipata miji kumi kwa kura kutoka kwa makabila, pamoja na nusu ya kabila la Manase.

vi.L: Và cho các con trai của Kê-hát còn lại, từ họ hàng của chi tộc, từ nửa chi tộc, nửa [chi tộc] Ma-na-se, bằng cách bắt thăm, mười thành.
vi.B: Con cháu Kê-hát còn lại nhận được mười thành bằng cách bắt thăm, từ gia tộc của chi tộc ấy và từ nửa chi tộc Ma-na-se.
vi.R: Những con cháu Kê-hát còn lại nhận được mười thành bằng cách bắt thăm, từ các chi tộc, trong đó có nửa chi tộc Ma-na-se.

ko.L: 그리고 남은 그핫 자손에게는 그 지파의 씨족에서, 지파의 절반, 곧 므낫세 반 [지파]에서 제비로 열 성읍을 [주었다].
ko.B: 그핫 자손의 나머지는 그 지파의 씨족과 므낫세 반 지파에서 제비를 뽑아 열 성읍을 받았다.
ko.R: 그핫 자손의 나머지는 므낫세 반 지파를 비롯한 여러 지파에서 제비를 뽑아 열 성읍을 받았다.

decisions.choice: the clan of the tribe: the name of the tribe seems to be missing
alternatives: from the clans of the tribe of Ephraim and from the tribe of Dan and from the half-tribe of Manasseh (Joshua 21:5)
decisions.reason: Joshua 21:5 reads "from the clans of the tribe of Ephraim and from the tribe of Dan and from the half of the tribe of Manasseh". Here "the tribe" has no name, and Ephraim and Dan are missing, probably lost in copying when the eye skipped from one "tribe" to the next. Verses 51-55 show that the ten towns came from Ephraim as well as Manasseh. The Hebrew text as it stands is followed.

decisions.choice: the remaining: the Kohathites who were not priests
decisions.reason: As in Joshua 21:5: the descendants of Aaron have been dealt with, and "the rest" are the other Kohathite families.

decisions.choice: from the tribes, including half the tribe of Manasseh
decisions.reason: Readable does not leave "the tribe" without a name; it speaks of the tribes in general and names Manasseh, as verses 51-55 bear out (m1).

records.literal_gloss: And to [the] sons of Gershom according to their clans, from [the] tribe of Issachar and from [the] tribe of Asher and from [the] tribe of Naphtali and from [the] tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, cities thirteen.

en.L: And to the sons of Gershom according to their clans, from the tribe of Issachar and from the tribe of Asher and from the tribe of Naphtali and from the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
en.B: The descendants of Gershom, clan by clan, received thirteen towns from the tribes of Issachar, Asher and Naphtali and from the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.
en.R: Gershom's descendants, clan by clan, received thirteen towns from the tribes of Issachar, Asher and Naphtali and from the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.

es.L: Y a los hijos de Gersón según sus clanes, de la tribu de Isacar y de la tribu de Aser y de la tribu de Neftalí y de la tribu de Manasés en Basán, trece ciudades.
es.B: Los descendientes de Gersón, clan por clan, recibieron trece ciudades de las tribus de Isacar, Aser y Neftalí, y de la tribu de Manasés en Basán.
es.R: Los descendientes de Gersón, clan por clan, recibieron trece ciudades de las tribus de Isacar, Aser y Neftalí, y de la tribu de Manasés en Basán.

fr.L: Et aux fils de Guershom selon leurs clans, de la tribu d’Issacar, et de la tribu d’Aser, et de la tribu de Nephtali, et de la tribu de Manassé en Bashân, treize villes.
fr.B: Les descendants de Guershom, clan par clan, reçurent treize villes des tribus d’Issacar, d’Aser et de Nephtali, et de la tribu de Manassé en Bashân.
fr.R: Les descendants de Guershom, clan par clan, ont reçu treize villes des tribus d’Issacar, d’Aser et de Nephtali, et de la tribu de Manassé en Bashân.

sw.L: Na kwa wana wa Gershomu kwa koo zao, kutoka kabila la Isakari na kutoka kabila la Asheri na kutoka kabila la Naftali na kutoka kabila la Manase huko Bashani, miji kumi na mitatu.

sw.R: Wazao wa Gershomu, ukoo kwa ukoo, walipata miji kumi na mitatu kutoka makabila ya Isakari, Asheri na Naftali, na kutoka kabila la Manase huko Bashani.

en.R: From the tribes of Judah, Simeon and Benjamin they gave by lot the towns that have been listed by name.

ko.R: 그들은 유다, 시므온, 베냐민 지파에서, 앞에서 이름을 든 성읍들을 제비를 뽑아 주었다.

decisions.choice: as in Joshua 21:9, with Benjamin added
decisions.reason: Joshua 21:9 introduces the priests' towns from Judah and Simeon before they are named. Chronicles adds Benjamin and "by lot", and the words here refer to the priests' towns already named in verses 40-45.

decisions.choice: which they called by names: which are mentioned by name
decisions.reason: The verb has no named subject; it is an impersonal way of saying the towns are named one by one, as in Joshua 21:9.

decisions.choice: that have been listed by name
decisions.reason: Readable points back to the list in verses 40-45 (m1).

en.B: As for some of the clans of the descendants of Kohath, the towns of their territory came from the tribe of Ephraim.
en.R: Some of the Kohathite clans were given towns from the tribe of Ephraim as their land.

es.L: Y [en cuanto a] algunos de los clanes de los hijos de Coat, las ciudades de su territorio fueron de la tribu de Efraín.
es.B: En cuanto a algunos de los clanes de los descendientes de Coat, las ciudades de su territorio provinieron de la tribu de Efraín.
es.R: Algunos de los clanes de Coat recibieron ciudades de la tribu de Efraín como su tierra.

vi.B: Còn một số gia tộc thuộc con cháu Kê-hát thì nhận các thành trong địa phận của mình từ chi tộc Ép-ra-im.
vi.R: Một số gia tộc Kê-hát được cấp các thành từ chi tộc Ép-ra-im làm đất của mình.

ko.L: 그리고 그핫 자손의 씨족들 가운데 [몇몇에게는] 그들의 영토의 성읍들이 에브라임 지파에서 [나왔다].
ko.B: 그핫 자손의 씨족 가운데 몇몇은 에브라임 지파에서 그들의 영토가 될 성읍들을 받았다.
ko.R: 그핫 씨족 가운데 몇몇은 에브라임 지파에서 성읍들을 받아 자기 땅으로 삼았다.

decisions.choice: from the clans ... and were: some of the clans; the sentence starts again
decisions.reason: "From the clans" means "some of the clans". The sentence names the group and then begins again: "and the cities of their territory were ...". These are the Kohathites who were not priests (verse 46).

decisions.choice: the cities of their territory: Joshua 21:20 has "the cities of their lot"
decisions.reason: Joshua speaks of the towns that fell to them by lot; Chronicles calls them the towns of their territory. Both mean the towns they were given.

decisions.choice: [as for] some of
decisions.reason: Literal brackets the words that show how the opening phrase connects to the rest.

fr.L: Et ils leur donnèrent les villes de refuge : Sichem et ses pâturages, dans la montagne d’Éphraïm, et Guézer et ses pâturages,

fr.R: On leur a donné Sichem et ses pâturages, dans la région montagneuse d’Éphraïm. Sichem était une des villes de refuge. On leur a aussi donné Guézer et ses pâturages.

sw.R: Waliwapa Shekemu na malisho yake katika nchi ya milima ya Efraimu. Shekemu ulikuwa mmojawapo wa miji ya usalama. Waliwapa pia Gezeri na malisho yake.

ko.L: 그리고 그들에게 도피성들, 곧 에브라임 산지에 있는 세겜과 그 목초지와, 게셀과 그 목초지와,
ko.B: 그들에게는 도피성 가운데 하나인 에브라임 산지의 세겜과 그 목초지와 함께, 게셀과 그 목초지와,
ko.R: 그들은 그핫 자손에게 에브라임 산지에 있는 세겜과 그 목초지를 주었다. 세겜은 피난 성읍 가운데 하나였다. 또 게셀과 그 목초지와,

decisions.choice: the cities of refuge: Shechem as one of the cities of refuge
decisions.reason: As in verse 42: the Hebrew has the plural, but only Shechem was a city of refuge (Joshua 20:7); Joshua 21:21 has the singular.

decisions.choice: Gezer: a town where Canaanites still lived
decisions.reason: Ephraim did not drive out the Canaanites of Gezer (Joshua 16:10); much later Pharaoh took it and gave it to Solomon (1 Kings 9:16).

decisions.choice: one of the cities of refuge (Balanced); one of the towns of safety (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in verse 42.
